greet.text: A boy of about seven, holding a lantern nearly as big as he is. "Are you staying up till midnight? You have to. If you go to sleep the lights get in."

choices.text: What happens if a light gets in?

get_in.text: "It drinks your breath and you don't wake up." He says it with total confidence, then looks less sure. "Mam says. But Mam also says the goats can hear you lying."
